t:
I think you already guessed the bitter truth, so I'm only scattering your last doubts. The Great Experiment and the Cataclysm are one and the same!
Blinded by our pride, we searched for ways to grow our power and we found the Sources. We had no idea then what the Seals were and why they were important. Every one of us the Great Mages wanted only one thing - power, free power!
 We tried to subdue the power of the Seals. When our first attempt failed, we continued to attack the Source Seal again and again with the most powerful spells till it cracked and gushed its power into the world. Power against power, understand? The Seals could not bear it, the world's shell cracked and the Astral put an end to the Sarnaut as I knew it. You know the rest - the world in ruins, the legend of the Patrons, the Great Mages being the last stronghold of order in a realm of chaos... But I see that you don't seem to believe my words.

Tep... Till this day, I can't help but marvel at the power hidden in his madness. Who'd ever thought that someone who died once would almost succeed in pulling the whole world into nothingness with him?
I am scared by how easily Tep would extinguish his enemies. By how easily he created an entire world, albeit an illusory one. If that's not divine power, then it's very, very close. And I have an idea what the secret of his incredible power is. The Seals!
I know Tep had experimented with a small fragment of one of the Seals and derived the power to create his Plague from it. It is one of the manifestations of the Sources - the manifestation of Death. But the Pyramid... Illusions, energy, matter, creating new life and influencing the mind. A full set of powers accessible to the Great Mages, reinforced by extremely sophisticated spells. No, I don't believe Tep could achieve all that by himself. After all, until recently he was but a body howling in pain, suspended between life and death. I'm sure someone helped Tep! Someone who knows everything about our Great Experiment.
r147627.n: Ask the Great Mage's soul about Tep

t: It doesn't matter if you know about me. What matters is what I know about you!
r147628.n: It doesn't matter if you know about me. What matters is what I know…

t:
The postal service is one of civilization's greatest achievements. Thanks to a network of portals and hardworking postal workers, letters and packages arrive at their destinations without delay!
Postal workers can be found throughout all of the Allods. Each one is trained to provide the same quality of service and meet all of your mailing needs! You can send letters and packages to your friends and they will be delivered for a small fee. You can also check your mail and see if someone sent something to you.
Remember that letters and packages are stored for no longer than thirty days. You should check your mailbox from time to time so you don't lose important or valuable mail. Thank you for using the postal service and have a nice day!
Talk to Goblin Banker at the Boutique to be able to use mail from any point of Sarnaut.
r147671.n: The postal service is one of civilization's greatest achievements.…

t: Here you are! May you find the Revelation!... If it actually exists at all, that is.

Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters.
Here, take it. I have plenty of these.
r147674.n: Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters. Here, take…

t:
Ah!
Another letter that appeared from nowhere! I remember I saw it before!
r147675.n: Ah! Another letter that appeared from nowhere! I remember I saw it…

t:
Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters.
Here, take it. I have plenty of these.
Have you lost it? No problem, Vseslav was wise enough to have sent several copies. Here's one.
Oh yes, the letter, written on birch bark instead of paper. What's wrong with it?
Excellent! Now let's assail the Citadel!

Greetings! I've heard a lot about your deeds, and honestly, I'm happy that a hero like you is joining us for our research mission. I'm sure together we will find the answers to all the questions that are bothering you!

Now here is the deal. The Citadel's main weapon, the destructive beam, was eliminated, but there are still lots of bloodsuckers inside. Still the real threat comes from Amadeus, the spirit of the Citadel. I hope I can reprogram it. Our faith in Light will protect us from the darkness that has saturated these walls!

Are you with us?
r147694.n: Greetings! I've heard a lot about your deeds, and honestly, I'm happy…

t: Wrong password. Premises sealed. Unauthorized access attempt reported to the security. Please remain on the spot and await your extermination.
Unauthorized access attempt detected. Please stop violating my intelligence and await your extermination.

I am Amadeus and I've been specifically created to work on this Darkblood Citadel.

I possess keen intuition and am fully conversational. Vocabulary - ten thousand words. Emotions deactivated. For detailed instructions see my developer - the Great Mage Gorluxor.

Confirm your status.
r147744.n: I am Amadeus and I've been specifically created to work on this…

t: Ferris is an inexhaustible source of mysteries. Who are these Tungars, for instance? Degraded goblins or evolved walruses? Nobody knows...
r147851.n: Ferris is an inexhaustible source of mysteries. Who are these Tungars,…

r147953.n: Try to negotiate with the Shaman with Zimina's help

t: Gyr! Baba! Tunga alala! Hohog oga?
r147954.n: Gyr! Baba! Tunga alala! Hohog oga?

t: It was my shift on the watch. Me and Elena were supposed to patrol the camp perrimeter. She took on the northern part, and I took on the southern one. I frroze my tail off through the shift as I was supposed to, and then came back to the camp, but Elena wasn't there! Ay-hya! Me and Herbert have been rrunning off our legs since then, but still no sign of our beauty!
r148250.n: Ask how Elena has gone missing

t: Aho! You owe me one, frriend! I sweated my back off when I was carrying you across the ice, while fighting off Tungars and lynxes!
r148251.n: Aho! You owe me one, frriend! I sweated my back off when I was…

t:
It turns out to be a journal covered in thick dirt. Once hard pages are now sodden and stick to the fingers like dough. Finally, the cover comes off from the pages. The first page is covered with writings and drawings - those are experiments' results and mysterious half-obliterated schemes.

But there are even more interesting inscriptions on the cover. It seems to be some kind of a code... Or a part of it. Maybe it will help us open the door to the Bestiary? Alas, there is no way to make it out...

We should search around. Maybe other scientists managed to escape and dropped some papers on the run. If we find more pieces with that code written on them, we will be able to retrieve it by parts.

The skeleton was wearing a tattered robe that resembles Imperial uniform of the scientists from the vision. The stained patch on the sleeve reads "Vasily Dankin". So he didn't manage to escape after all.

There is a square object under the scientists' bones. What could it possibly be?
r148525.n: The skeleton was wearing a tattered robe that resembles Imperial…

t:
Haha, what are you saying? Oh, the "Gates"... I misheard you.

Nah, I don't know anything about it. But I would beat the hell out of those Cultists, you bet, huh! Have I told you that I used to work for Gorluxor? I was his personal guardian, that's right. And when he started his affair with Asee-Teph, that temple, I knew right away that it wasn't going to end well. So I pulled up stakes and took off as soon as you showed up, huh.

Honestly, I think that blasted necromancy will bite us all later. The Zems should have just stayed in their graves where they belonged. Take that Mekhdi. He pisses me off! He talks to me as if I were a dumb goblin. Next time he says something, I will kick him off the allod, I swear.
r148584.n: Ask about the "Gates" project and its connection to Tep Cultists.

t: At least we don't have to wear skins anymore. I was itching all over as if I was sick or something, huh.
r148585.n: At least we don't have to wear skins anymore. I was itching all over…

t: Suspicious dents and scratches can be seen on the Mechanoid body. Looks like some giant beast tried to taste it. One should rather stay away from that creature.
The wreckage of the Imperial Mechanoid has been lying here for so long it got fleeced with moss and inhabited by an ant colony.
r148591.n: The wreckage of the Imperial Mechanoid has been lying here for so long…

t: The Mechanoid must have been lying here for not too long - its metal body hasn't even lost its polish. Seems like it was destroyed by the local automatic security system. There is nothing else peculiar about it.
Tep's technology is way too distinctive. This Mechanoid obviously belonged to his army.
r148599.n: Tep's technology is way too distinctive. This Mechanoid obviously…

t: One shot from an Imperial Mechanoid was enough to put an end to the useless life of that Cultist.
Corpse of an Arisen dressed as a Tep Cultist. Good riddance.
r148603.n: Corpse of an Arisen dressed as a Tep Cultist. Good riddance.

t: On closer examination it turns out that some of the bones are missing, and the rest of them are gnawed by giant teeth. Still the cause of death cannot be determined.
A pile of decayed bones that, judging by the skull shape, belonged to an orc.
r148607.n: A pile of decayed bones that, judging by the skull shape, belonged to…

t:
I'm afraid I don't know much more than you do. And I don't like it!

After those kidnappings and your mysterious disappearance everyone in the camp has been watching after each other. They are afraid to lose someone else, and I can understand that. Everyone will be on their toes if anything happens.

Herbert has been keeping an eye on me. Sometimes it seems to me that... erm... he has fallen in love with me. Don't get me wrong, he's a nice man in every respect... but I'm on duty! We work together! I don't know what to do about him.
r148644.n: Ask about the "Gates" project and its connection to Tep Cultists.

t:
I've told you everything I knew. Sorry, I haven't found out anything new since.

After those kidnappings and your mysterious disappearance everyone in the camp has been watching after each other. I can feel someone's gaze on my back all the time. Either Murk, or Herbert, and now the Prowls, too. They are afraid to lose someone else, and I can understand that. But it's just impossible to work under such conditions!

And you know... It seems that Herbert... erm... has fallen in love with me. Don't get me wrong, he's a nice man in every respect... but I'm on duty! I don't know what to do about him.
r148645.n: Ask about the "Gates" project and its connection to Tep Cultists.

t: Grreat! Now let's get away from here. Don't let Tungars notice you. You can't fight them all!
At last! I thought you abandoned me!
r148768.n: At last! I thought you abandoned me!

r148797.n: Try to communicate with the savage through gestures

t: I am Humk! Uga-gash-kyrshylee! Goody-gods! No beat! Murk!
r148798.n: I am Humk! Uga-gash-kyrshylee! Goody-gods! No beat! Murk!

t:
You... You are right in time. They were about to slaughter me!

Your appearance was... extravagant. The savages were scared out of their minds! That was Murk's idea, wasn't it? I should give him a kiss when it's over.

Ahem... You say that these Mechanoids look just like the Tep's minions that you saw on Irdrich. They were all destructed by some kind of mechanical impact. If there has been a fight, it was really long ago.

Look, their wreckages are arranged as if they were a trophy... Or an offering!

Maybe they were destroyed by that snow creature? Maybe Tep and his Mechanoids were those demons that Tungars are so afraid of? And they worship their icy god - a giant worm that... Where is it gone, by the way? I think it disappeared in a crack in the far corner of the cave.

Will you inspect it? I can't really walk yet. I hope they have a healer in the camp...
I'd never thought I'd see a primitive savage ritual from the inside!
r148864.n: I'd never thought I'd see a primitive savage ritual from the inside!

t: Aho, friend! We're about to start a nice hunt!
r148915.n: Aho, friend! We're about to start a nice hunt!

t: What?! I will tear your lying tongue out! One cannot deceive those who have seen the truth!

How dare you open your mouth in the presence of someone who has been through all the nine stages of torment? Impudent worm!

Answer me, slave, where is the Source? It must be somewhere near, and your stupid robots won't stop us! Jeeg - may his name be cursed! - has betrayed our Master! He fooled your stupid Nezeb, your dumb scientists, who thought they could fathom the divine nature of the Source... But he didn't fool us!

Where is the Source, slave?!
What... Where is Negus Jeeg? That filthy jackal that betrayed our Master? I will tear his heart out and feed it to desert centipedes, I swear on the three Pillars of Truth!
r149101.n: What... Where is Negus Jeeg? That filthy jackal that betrayed our…

t:
I don't know, kylys. I know that she is lying, and that you are playing along with her. Only a fool doesn't see that.

The question is, why are you doing this. If I find out that you are going to hurt Herbert or leave him behind, you will pay for that, rest assured. Everyone may have secrets, but as long as you don't mess with our mission, I don't care.

Am I being clear?
r149281.n: Ask what Murk thinks of Zimina

t: Here everything smells with rrot. And lies.
r149282.n: Here everything smells with rrot. And lies.

t: What a weird material. Wait... What is going on?
This echo gives me the chills...
r149306.n: This echo gives me the chills...

t:
Well, you are not a master of provocation, but we should try.

I don't have time for personal squabbling. I can use the local resources to crush you like annoying flies.

You won't reach me and Herbert. We cannot let you, not now. We are preparing to enter a better world, a world free of your disgusting chaos. Our love will overcome all obstacles!
r149327.n: Provoke the clone and bring it into an honest fight

t: Why are you here? Chasing me is pointless.
r149328.n: Why are you here? Chasing me is pointless.

r149399.n: Teleport to the caves at the second floor

r149419.n: It sounds like the elevator started working.
