r149463.n: The steel platform is quietly buzzing. It still preserves traces of…

t:
It's hard to tell. First, we need to get finished with the expedition and report to everyone involved. I believe you are yet to face many dangers on your way. One of them is right in front of us - a door to another world!

I believe Marianne and that Imperial lady will handle this. They are determined to crush the whole army of the Architects! A difficult battle lies ahead of you, that's for sure. Consider your duty to the expedition fulfilled. Thank you for everything - we would have never made it without your help.

But... If you don't mind, I have one last request for you. I have written down my observations regarding the clone. Please, give it to Yaver Gnostis. He will storm me with questions if I meet with him personally, and I really don't feel like answering them.

...The Sculptor looks at you curiously. The mask has chosen the right emotion again.

"An offer? How interesting. And unexpected. I guess I don't have a choice?"

...The Architect draws himself up. Now his voice sounds triumphantly.

"May it be so. If my freedom costs your life in Chaos, it is your choice. I hope you realize what you are dooming yourself to."
r149732.n: Offer salvation to the Sculptor in exchange for his help in closing the Gates

t:
...The mask slowly blinks.

"From the inside, of course. If you destroy it in the Fractal, it will be destroyed here as well."

...The Sculptor hesitates.

"If you destroy the Passage, they will not be able to enter this world. Your Ascent will be interrupted, and my mission will be failed. But my life will be saved. I feel... You have a word for this feeling. A strange word, a strange feeling... Dilemma."
r149733.n: Ask how the "Gates" can be closed

t:
...The Sculptor silently shakes his mask.

"I have been preparing your mind for a long time. The rest of the expedition will not endure my voice. You, too, cannot comprehend his design. We are the Architect. One day my words will make sense to you. One day, you will be touched by the Perfection."

...Solemn sound of his voice suddenly becomes softer.

"But I can try. I can feel that it is important for you."
r149734.n: Ask the Sculptor to talk to Herbert and others

t:
...The Sculptor shivers, as if from a blow. The mask shows the expression of sheer bliss, and then frowns.

"I cannot handle them now. If they accept me, I will be no more. I cannot let this happen. I will die. I cannot die now."

...The Sculptor falls silent. Dozens of expressions change each other on his face. At some point, it becomes absolutely smooth, almost glassy. Another place can be seen through it - the World of the Architects.

Then the face appears again, serene.
r149735.n: Ask why he stopped the Architects from coming through the "Gates"

t:
...The mask smiles shortly, copying Marianne de Ardeur's manner. The Sculptor's words can be barely heard, as if he is speaking to himself.

"They all refused at first. Thousands of worlds, Chaos of million kinds - they all look alike. In your fear, you all preserve one Order."

...An expression of surprise appears on the Sculptor's face. For the first time, he found the right expression.

"From Chaos, of course. You will become better, stronger and truer. You will be granted an infinite power - this is what the Ascent is. A Transmutation, if you wish. It is our mission. I hope you will forgive us for the delay. If I could, I would have furnished stronger resistance to your "Imperial scientists". I tried to transmute them, but now I see that eliminating would have been more effective. I am sorry."

...The Sculptor regretfully shakes his head.
r149737.n: Ask what Ascent means and what you have to be freed of

t:
The Sculptor looks back at the portal. As he turns, an uncanny expression of triumph appears on his mask.

"They are me. We. No, me. The Architect."

...The Sculptor becomes silent and shuffles his giant leg-stilts, as if in confusion.

"They want me back. I don't want to go back - I fell off the Fractal. There is nothing for us... for me. I closed the Passage, but soon they will be back, they will come for me, and then you will go through the Ascent. You will be freed, sooner or later. We promise."
r149738.n: Clarify that you were asking about the creatures from the portal

t:
...The Sculptor is listening, slightly nodding his mask. Its emotions change each other rather unexpectedly and inaptly.

"You are seeking to unearth the secrets of those who were here before you. You have discovered the biggest one. They all died in the end, like they should have. And you destroyed what was left of them."
r149739.n: Tell about the expedition and all the previous events.

t:
...The mask turns and slightly sinks, as if the Architect is actually looking at you. A ripple runs across its surface and the expression on the grotesque face slightly changes. It is... friendly?

The strange creature fills the room with quiet noise. Your ear doesn't recognize words, but they are imprinted in your consciousness in ice-cold letters:

"I am the Sculptor. Who are you?"
...The creature is silent. Its grotesque mask resembles a face and bears an expression of tranquility.
r149741.n: ...The creature is silent. Its grotesque mask resembles a face and…

t: The steel platform is quietly buzzing. It still preserves traces of old magic.
r149750.n: The steel platform is quietly buzzing. It still preserves traces of…

t:
I don't remember a thing... After I fell through the floor, the last thing that I saw was that giant vessel with a strange creature inside of it falling right at me. Then - only darkness...

The first thing that I saw after I woke up - you and Herbert. So I don't know more than you do. This is scary. What has happened to me?!
What are you doing here? What am I doing here?!
r149837.n: What are you doing here? What am I doing here?!

t:
I think we should go down and try to capture the crazy Arisen, and as for our clones... I think it would be the best to destroy them. Clones are unnatural! I almost lost my mind when I saw myself!

I wonder how did that maniac learn to clone. Clones, Mechanoids looking like Tep's servants... That's too much for an Imperial lab, don't you think? The Object really bothers me. We need to find out as much as possible about it, and to do so, we need to get to our mad experimenter.
I still can't believe in what happened. That freak stole my body, stole my memory... He stole me from me!
r149885.n: I still can't believe in what happened. That freak stole my body,…

t:
When I entered the vessel, an unknown power just broke my will. I stopped feeling my body! As if it didn't exist anymore; it fell into tiny particles and turned into a flow of information. And the cold tentacles started stirring those particles, sculpting a new me out of them!

And my consciousness... As if it was smashed against a clean white wall and left a distinct impression on it. I could see my own memory, I swear! I could remember everything that happened to me since I was born, every little detail... It was beautiful. But then something separated us, and I returned to my body, feeling as weak and tired as I was before. A terrible feeling, I must admit.
Oh, my head... I think my decision was a little too hasty.
r149892.n: Oh, my head... I think my decision was a little too hasty.

t:
Obviously, we are facing a source of a tremendous unknown power. No wonder Tep wanted to acquire it. But why did he leave Ferris? Why didn't he take the Object? What has transformed the scientists? Why has no one ever heard of the "Gates" Project? There are so many questions...

We need to study all the records! The scientists must have kept logs and made reports. We need to find out what our predecessors knew to keep surveying!

quests: Light in the End of the Tunnel

t:
You want to know my opinion?

See, those barricades face the central area, which means they were purposed to protect the staff from something coming out of the Laboratory, not from the outside. Maybe the unknown enemy got inside through a Portal, maybe the Mechanoids went crazy, maybe... anything could have happened! We still don't have a clue.

But one thing I know for sure - this place should have remained secret. The Imperial scientists on the barricades clearly were not prepared to the assault.
This place looks like a giant cemetery. I think we shouldn't have come to Ferris. Some mysteries should remain unraveled...
r150014.n: This place looks like a giant cemetery. I think we shouldn't have come…

t:
As Sarbaz Baybut said, the Sanitation Zone is swarming with Mechanoids. They seem to attack any living being that they see. We could hardly make it to the barricades. Their defenders must have fought to the last.

You know, these barricades are giving me a lot of questions. They were clearly hastily improvised, and we still don't know, what the Imperial scientists were hiding from.

quests: Поиски сокровищ: Память о том, что было
Поиски сокровищ: Память о том, что было

t:
January 1, 1000

"I can hear exalted voices coming from nowhere. The new millennia. The first day. Oh, this is so important. I am making an entry just to mark that. I should keep the track of time. Tick tack. It is so slow. I can keep up with it, even on my rusty prostheses. I think Tep was supposed to come in the past millennia. Or the next one? I don't remember."

...

June 5, 1010

"Here he is. Speak of the devil, hahahahaha!!! I offered to show him to the shower - he's been lying in the coffin for ages... He looked at me as if I was an idiot, that damned egghead. And his Mechanoids are ugly, though they were built according to my schemes. And he himself looks... wrong. The Source is more beautiful. The Source told me that Tep was just a drop in the bucket. That Tep was useless. I should drive Tep away from our home. He has nothing to do with this place."

...

June 12, 1010

"It's all smoking and shaking! I think Tep is angry. I never thought he could scream like that. It got really frightening at some point. Maybe he was practicing? I need to practice, too (will start tomorrow after lunch). The bad news is that the Source wasn't able to resist him. So if it were not for my Mechanoids, it would be dead by now. You need to say: Thank you, Negus Jeeg. Thank you for being here."
r150207.n: Read the notes about Tep's arrival

t:
October 5, 966

"I heard Nezeb died. I don't know who told me that, but I know it. That's amusing. I wanted to drink some champagne, but it's bad for my prostheses. I gave it to one of the blue-eyed. I think he liked it. I taught him to say "Glory to Tep!" Now he wanders around and mumbles it."

...

A summer month, 973

"He is silent. Everybody is silent. I am alone. A nice day."

...

New Year's Eve, 977

"Animals who call themselves Pridens have just broke in. They babble something about some Shoom branch and poke the Mechanoids with their hammers and sticks. Luckily, I have switched them off long ago."

...

January 14, 978 (as the furry ones say)

"I don't understand half of their savage words, but I like them (especially their forked cloaks!). The blue-eyed don't seem to notice them. Which means the Object doesn't care about their presence. But I have an idea."

...

June 2, 978

"Well, Tep can be proud of me. The tribe has left, determined to wipe out their home allod. I never knew I am so good at public speeches. Or was it the champagne? Ah, no... I've run out of it long ago."

...

Idontcarewhatdayitis, 986

"Perfection. I've achieved it. I've got nothing to eat, so I don't. It is easier than it seems - the blue-eyed know."

...

Lost track. Need to find it.

"I've cloned a deer. Just for the laughs. And food, of course. I don't think the blue-eyed are tasty, especially the wires."
r150208.n: Read other notes from the past decades

t:
June 30, 965

"Something weird is happening to my colleagues who have been working on the Object with me. First, Yasskul Tay and Sarbaz Korus went missing. And yesterday, I found Yaver Loku in the laboratory room, piercing herself with needles for bone sampling. When she saw me, she stretched her hands towards me and tried to say something, but her movement broke some of the needles, and suddenly she went into convulsion, hurting herself even more. I got rid of her body last night... And saw her again in the morning. In the security room. She was just standing there, staring into the surveillance camera screen, holding the head of the killed security orc in her hands (saw blue light in the eye pits). I paralyzed her and hid her in my room, tied by hands and leg. What is going on?"

...

September 19, 965

"Another body right in the middle of the main hall. Two bodies, to be more exact. A Xadaganian woman (laboratory technician from the agronomic department) and a goblin (shipyard mechanic). The Xadaganian's body and the goblin's head, jointed with strange blue and black fiber (Object's colors?). Concealing these peculiarities is no longer possible. Awaiting the Council inspection. Preparing for last-ditch measures. Tep's mission must be carried out."

...

November 25, 965

"Most of the staff tried to escape the complex. I destroyed the portal net after the Council agents arrived. Now they are all locked in here with me... The Astral storms won't let them fly Astral ships for the next two weeks, but still I sabotaged all the reactors - just in case. They will be able to leave the allod, but will inevitably explode in the Astral. The mentalists have already started brainwashing the staff. They must have received an order to carry out the full cleanup. Yesterday they saw one of the blue-eyed "returnees". He resisted and was destroyed at the spot... One of the mentalists has turned into a slobbery imbecile. That's interesting."

...

December 4, 965

...this entry breaks off abruptly. Something must have happened while it was written.

"The mentalists tried to get inside my head, too, but much to my surprise, they couldn't. They just couldn't. It had them puzzled, and me, too. I'm writing it being "arrested in quarters" in my room. The cult won't help me. We are too weak yet. Looks like I will ha..."

...

January 14, 966

"I don't remember the last month. Since the previous entry everything was as in a fog. Today I woke up in the middle of an empty corridor, surrounded by my former colleagues. Those blue eyes and the ringing silence. They didn't bother me though. I was calm. But what has happened in that month?"

...

January 15, 966

"The Mechanoids are dragging the dead bodies from all over the complex and throw them into the Astral. Is that how they get rid of the evidence? Wrecks of the Astral ships are floating over the allod - they tried to escape anyway... Idiots. For now, I haven't come across a single living (sentient) being on the whole territory of the complex. But I've seen Nezeb's stamp on a document in my office. The Council has shut down the whole research. The complex exists no more. The ghost complex. And I am its only inhabitant."
r150209.n: Read the notes on the sealing of the complex

t:
April 11, 965

"I've heard Skrakan had found a way to fight demons. Now when all the eyes of the world are watching him, my hands are free. During the last year, I have gradually replaced all the members of the Gates research team. Now I can trust most of them, and the rest are just expendables - orcs, mostly. We don't have much time. The next few weeks are going to define the outcome of my operation."

...

April 18, 965

"The Object is barely responding to its surroundings. We keep recording weak splashes of energy, but still know too little about what is inside of it - a magical life form? An ancient mechanism? One of the "expendables" stated that he saw a weird light coming out of the Object at 4 a.m. on April, 15. We took note of his words and eliminated him before he had time to tell anyone else. (Reminder: assign writing an obitual.) We don't have the right to risk."

...

April 19, 965

...Another piece of paper is attached above the page. It must be a fragment of another Object research log. The researcher's hand-written notes cover a printed text.

"Inspection record #45. Numerous micro cracks have appeared on the surface of the Object (caused by the internal pressure. Of what?) On closer inspection, a dim blue light can be seen in the cracks, flashing at 36.3 second intervals (the color keeps changing within blue and green spectrum, depending on the surrounding noisiness). The interval slowly reduces (to 35.1 seconds in 9-hour observation). The Object produces a low humming and slightly vibrates, but does not respond to external irritants. Despite the obvious burst of activity, its temperature does not change and remains at the indoor level. All our attempts to heat or cool the Object were failed (try the experimental ship cannon?). End of record."

...

May 1, 965

"An undesired accident happened. While I was away, the Object came alive and tried to "make first contact", as Sarang Sargass put it. During 30 minutes, the Objects was producing series of low sounds, which became "progressively melodic and questioning" (?). The process started at 11:47 a.m., when the interval between the flashes, according to our calculations, had to come down to zero. After the supposed contact attempt, the blue light faded. The vibration and the humming stopped. The Object is giving no signs of activity."
r150210.n: Read the notes on the Object research, dated by 965

t:
January 11, 964

"The sudden death of Vasily Dankin has led to my appointment as the Head of the Research Complex. My little game has resulted in my full victory even earlier than I could imagine. Now all the staff are pawns in my hands... and Tep's hands. Soon their Sparks will follow that of Dankin. Soon. But not now. For now, I need them."

...

March 26, 964

"A Council agent has personally arrived to Ferris to supervise the development of the new ship prototype. I had no other choice but to demonstrate him the efficiency of the experimental ship reactor... Too bad he won't be able to tell anyone about it - there's just a handful of dust left of him. The Empire will have to cope without its new ships. Tep does not want the League to fall... I've just sent the schemes of experimental Mechanoids to my associates."

...

September 3, 964

"The Object seems to be hiding more mysteries than the Great Mages could have ever imagined... and neither could have Tep. Beyond all doubt, this is a source of a great power. I am finally on the right track."
r150211.n: Read the notes on Negus Jeeg's appointment as the Head of the Research Complex

t: Hickut, you say? Let me see... Oh, it is indeed. Finally I have something to do. Give me a couple of minutes, I will translate it.
Good day. How may I help you?
r150213.n: Good day. How may I help you?

t: Where would you like to go:
You can go to other parts of Ferris.
r150258.n: You can go to other parts of Ferris.

t:
You think this crystal caused the mutation? It is hard to believe that. Those mutations are random, there are no two similar cases, so I think it would be more accurate to call it modification - a deliberate interference into the living organisms - rather than mutation.

I think you should talk to Herbert. He knows more about these things.
Weird things happen around. The more I know, the more I want to get away from here.
r150310.n: Weird things happen around. The more I know, the more I want to get…

t:
Oh, you've heard about my old hobby? I think some ships in the port of Novograd are still moored with my chains. I had to make a living somehow back in the day...

You say you need a chain? I guess I can help you with that. Watch and learn!
r150343.n: Ask for help with crafting the chain

t: Excellent! Wait a second, I'll charge the Mana Converter... Here you go! Runs like clockwork now. At least I hope so...

A crystal as the source of the mutation? It can't be!

Yes, I can sense that it radiates some energy, but I fail to recognize its nature. If it is magic, then it is really unusual. But I have no doubt that this crystal was extracted from the meteorite at the bottom of the lake and transported to the Bestiary. What does it mean? It means two things!

The first thing is, the crystal was the key subject of the scientists' research. Maybe the constant exposure to its radiation caused the unexpected consequences.

The second thing, we don't know for sure whether the experiment failed, or was successful. The Bestiary has been abandoned for too long, and we don't know whether the mutated animals were bred on purpose, or the mutation was a side effect.

You know... I think you should speak to someone who knows more about technology and magic than anyone in Sarnaut. To Catherina!
Finally! I thought we would have to stay in those frozen lands forever, lost in conjectures. I feel that we are close to very important discoveries!
r150346.n: Finally! I thought we would have to stay in those frozen lands…

t:
A meteorite on the bottom of the lake? Time travel to the past? A Xadaganian commander of an army of metal soldiers? What were Imperial soldiers doing here?

It was a closed allod! Neither the League nor the Empire knew of its existence! It could have made some sense if you'd seen Tep's servants. I'm sorry, but you story sounds more like a hallucination caused by hypothermia and suffocation.

No, no, and no! I'm not sending anyone to the lake to search for evidence of your hallucinations. We are under an emergency anyway - Elena, my precious muse, has gone!

You don't believe me? Ask Murk! He was the last one to see her!
I couldn't even imagine how many mysteries this tiny piece of unexplored land conceals. And we are the first ones to discover it! Isn't it amazing?
r150376.n: I couldn't even imagine how many mysteries this tiny piece of…

t:
Oh great Tensess, give me patience...

I asked you to stay out of trouble, didn't I?! What have you done?! You slaughtered a whole camp of harmless local inhabitants! I... I don't even know what to say!

Alright, nevermind the savages. My wings are already blue from cold. You say they have warm tents? And a Portal? Huh... Well then, on behalf of all Surveyors, I express gratitude for the thorough genoc... I mean, assimilation of the hostile aborigines. We will study their cultural heritage later. We will send a couple... No, a squad of cultural experts on a research. And arrange a cultural patrol zone.

Come on, lead us to the camp before we turned into icicles!
r150380.n: Report on clearing the camp and locating the Portal

t: Brrr! It's so cold! I wonder what the locals eat? Icicles for breakfast, ice fricasse for lunch, and snow soup for dinner?
r150381.n: Brrr! It's so cold! I wonder what the locals eat? Icicles for…

t: Off we go! The riddles of history are waiting for us!

I don't know much more than you do. Pridens don't have a developed writing system, so they pass on their history by word of mouth... Such an irresponsibility! This is just unbelievable.

Sorry, where was I... Well, one of the doolgas told us that Ferris is an extremely cold allod. Supposedly, it is completely covered with ice. We don't know what Tep's Cultists were doing there, or whether they were there at all. That's what we need to find out.

According to the coordinates that Zayan has calculated, Ferris is located quite close to the habitable lands of Sarnaut, but it is rather "deep". It is hard to believe that, but Ferris is probably one of the few stable objects in the deep layers of the Astral. And we will be the first ones to reveal its mysteries... Oh, I'm looking forward to this!

Well... Our objective is quite simple - reach Ferris and find proofs of my tutor's hypotheses. As long as I've known him, the old man has never been wrong!

But nobody knows what is waiting for us on Ferris, so we have picked out the strongest and toughest historians. Our expedition is fully self-sustainable, so in case of any trouble we will deal with it on our own. Out team includes experienced fighters, keen hunters, and talented engineers... We are ready to face any unexpected circumstances!
Whoa! Now this is what I call a research mission. I'm so sick of burrowing among dusty manuscripts!
r150400.n: Whoa! Now this is what I call a research mission. I'm so sick of…

t: Greetings, ! If you seek adventures in the unknown, you are a good fit for the Imperial Fleet! Every day we launch new campaigns to explore Astral sectors and strengthen our position there. You will find our current directives on my table.
r150430.n: Greetings, ! If you seek adventures in the unknown, you are a good fit…

t:
Don't be so testy!

Yes, the events that are taking place are very dramatic. However, you and I are in the same boat now.

So... Sarnaut. A poor little world split into pieces, with a deity trapped inside. Inhabited by very quarrelsome races, and most of them are natural-born destroyers.

So what do we do with it?

Well, for starters, I will become the absolute ruler of your world. Everyone must obey me. Really, it's such a small thing. To control my future subjects, I will need an army, and fortunately you have already assembled one of those. Yes, yes, I'm talking about that army of the undead that stormed the Citadel. I'll take it, thank you for this generous gift.

Besides, as you already know, I don't really like it when someone dies. Now no one will die. This is the Gift of Hirkalla, which will replace the Gift of Tensess, or rather the Gift of Nihaz. Perhaps we will also bring back all those who died - existing as Sparks in a box doesn't sound very exciting, if you ask me. I will think of a job for those souls.

Of course, such a population will require a lot of space. I'm going to restore your little world from separate allods into something whole. Of course, it won't be easy, and I'll need the help of these Great Mages of yours.

And finally, we will destroy all these gods - the All-Mother's parasites. They're out there somewhere, waging an endless war. But I'm sure they don't stand a chance against you, the people of Sarnaut.
Well, shall we speak? I'm going to make quite a few changes...
r150495.n: Well, shall we speak? I'm going to make quite a few changes...

t: Empty threats. Try to stay alive for a start.

Now I'll say goodbye. I have other matters to attend to - like this interesting little world I've been observing. And I'll be taking my demons with me.

I have plenty of time left, and you... you stay here. Perhaps we will meet again in a few thousand years. I'm curious to see what you will have achieved by then.
Wonderful! I knew you'd understand! Alright, now I need to prove my case to everyone else. I need to carry out more research. I guess I'll have to go back to the desert.
r150841.n: Of course, I trust you. [Alice will remember that]

t: That's too bad! But I think my research will prove that I'm right. I just need to carry out more research. I guess I'll have to go back to the desert.
r150842.n: No, I don't trust you. [Alice will remember that]

t:
Good question!

I think you'll find this interesting. The Ambrosia is materialized energy, something like mana which is materialized astral energy. But unlike mana, the Ambrosia is more concentrated. Which means, you if you use it as fuel for ships or mana stations, the energy output will be a hundred times greater! Imagine the potential!

It also has a strong vitalizing effect. Heals wounds, reduces fatigue. However, in large amounts it changes creatures... But if we determine a correct dose...

And another fact. There's a similarity between the Ambrosia and the sap of the Ancient Trees.

Do you believe me or not?
r150843.n: Have you learned anything about the Ambrosia?

t: What's so strange? I changed into my uniform. I'm a pioneer. Can't just walk around the city in my exobiologist suit.
r150844.n: Alice, is that you? Why do you look so strange?

t: Greetings. How is your research going?
r150845.n: Greetings. How is your research going?

r151166.n: Fine, I'll take it! [You will spend {cost}]

r151169.n: Great, I'll take it! [You will spend {cost}]

t: Great! Don't forget to buy another pack later!
Good luck finding someone who will sell you this much water for less.
The same pack? Another ten bottles? Hmm... If you buy ten more bottles later... Then fine, I'll lower the price to {costM}.
r151174.n: I have a counteroffer. I'll pay you {costA} now, and I'll buy the same pack next time!

t: Well, then there's no water for you!
r151175.n: No, it's just water, not Mirra. You're asking an exorbitant price. {cost} is too much...

t:
It's true. But the water here was never priced at that. Still, as the first customer of the day, you get a discount.

I'll sell it to you for {costM}.
r151176.n: It's a bit expensive. Since I'm buying it in bulk, can you give me a discount? How about…

t: Hah, for that price you can get your water from the nearest river.
r151178.n: How much?! No, I'm not paying more than {cost}!

t: That's my kind of customer! I'll sell you ten bottles for {cost}. It's the desert after all, and water is valuable here!
r151179.n: Yes, I need ten bottles. How much will that be?

t: Greetings, greetings! Are you going on a trip or just restocking? It's the best water in the city, I'll even give you a discount.
r151180.n: Greetings, greetings! Are you going on a trip or just restocking? It's…

t: These are high quality tools, you won't regret it!
They are good tools, don't worry!
r151210.n: Well, then. Give it here. [You will spend {cost}]

t: That's more like it. Tell everyone about my shop. Bring your relatives. I have everything!
r151213.n: Fine, I'll take your word for it. Give the box here. [You will spend {cost}]

t: You won't find them cheaper anywhere. Well, it's your choice...
r151214.n: I'm not paying that for them. {cost} is too much...

t: They are in great condition, like new. Ah, fine. {costM}, then. But not a coin less!
r151215.n: It's still expensive. Let's make it {costA}, then I'll take it. I don't like the look of…

t: That's not junk! They are all rarities... Ah, why do I bother!
r151216.n: {cost}? For this rusty junk? Are you taking me for a fool?

t: The box might be old. But it's like new, it was barely used. Alright, I'll sell it to you for {costM}.
r151217.n: Look... The box has holes in it, so any metal has probably rusted... But I'm willing to…

t: That's robbery! I'm not selling you anything!
r151219.n: What is this box of old junk? Let's make it {cost}, then I'll consider it...

t: Here are the papers. I'll get it ready - you'll be able to collect the camel very soon.
r151227.n: Just what I need. [You will spend {cost}]

t: This camel will turn your life around! Here are the papers. I'll get it ready - you'll be able to collect the camel very soon.
r151230.n: Ah, fine. I'll take it. [You will spend {cost}]

t: Just remember: you have to be gentle with camels. They are proud animals. Here are the papers. I'll get it ready - you'll be able to collect the camel very soon.
Then you can trek across the desert on foot!
That will put me out of business, but you're right. Camels haven't been in great demand recently. Alright, I'll lower the price to {costM}.
r151235.n: I see you haven't sold a lot of camels lately. If you knock a few coins off the price,…

t: A camel costs more in the desert, especially when the closest oasis is 3 days away, and you're out of water.
r151236.n: You'll never sell it for this much. A camel is not worth {cost}.

t:
No, that's not enough. That won't even get you a mule, let alone a camel. But alright, I'm willing to give you a discount.

I'll sell it to you for {costM}.
r151237.n: No, I can't afford that. How about {costA}?

t: That's not nice... I guess you don't need a camel that much, then. I'm not one to insist...
r151239.n: Is this camel made of gold? I'll pay {cost}!

t: I can offer you a great camel for {cost}. It's good-tempered and can carry as much as two horses!
r151240.n: Yes, I need a camel. Preferably a fast one, but only if it's not too expensive.

t: Good afternoon! Going on a journey to the desert? My camels are the best in the area!
r151241.n: Good afternoon! Going on a journey to the desert? My camels are the…

t:
I was hoping you'd say that. Listen.

The local Orcs have a large part to play in what's about to happen on Suslanger. Don't ask me how I know that.

I'm asking you not to kill any of them. Prove that heroes can save lives, not just end them.

And that's about it.
r151509.n: Of course, I trust you. [Alice will remember that]

t:
Well... I can understand it, but I'm not happy about it. Still, I must say something.

The local Orcs have a large part to play in what's about to happen on Suslanger. Don't ask me how I know that.

I'm asking you not to kill any of them. Prove that heroes can save lives, not just end them.

And that's about it.
r151510.n: No, I don't trust you. [Alice will remember that]

t:
Yes. To make sure we mean something to each other after everything that happened.

I understand that our meeting was a strange one, but I still hope you have more reasons to trust me than to doubt me. Trust is very important to me...

Before I tell you my last request for today, I want to hear you say it again. Do you trust me or not?
I can say I'm proud of you!
r151512.n: I can say I'm proud of you!

t:
I'm glad to hear that. Trust is an important thing in the desert...

See the frame of a ship over there? If I correctly estimate the power of this car, we'll have enough speed to drive over it and jump right into that huge stone arch... And the rest of the Orc manamobiles won't be able to do it.

Before they realize where they can catch us, we'll make it to the city... I hope. I'm not sure where we will end up...

Is everything clear?
r151568.n: Of course, I trust you. [Alice will remember that]

t:
This will complicate things in the future... But you don't have a choice here.

See the frame of a ship over there? If I correctly estimate the power of this car, we'll have enough speed to drive over it and jump right into that huge stone arch... And the rest of the Orc manamobiles won't be able to do it.

Before they realize where they can catch us, we'll make it to the city... I hope. I'm not sure where we will end up...

Is everything clear?
r151569.n: No, I don't. [Alice will remember that]

t:
Yes. The thing is, taking the main road would be suicide. The Orcs would intercept us.

We'll have to take... A slightly unusual route - it will also be suicide, but the chances of a happy outcome are much higher.

So before we start the engine, I need to know - do you trust me or not?
r151570.n: You wanted to discuss something before we leave?

t: Oh... I don't have much left either! Alright, take some, but use it sparingly!
r151575.n: Could you give me some water...?

t: You have a bag full of it! Absolutely not...
r151576.n: Could you give me some water...?

t: Just look at her. What a beauty!
r151577.n: Just look at her. What a beauty!

r151692.n: That's even stranger... Alright, let's do it.

t: Ha ha! I'm kidding! Who needs that nonsense? Go stand in the center, and I'll say the right words - you'll be off in no time...
The portal systems are in motion...
The portal hums quietly and surprisingly evenly.
r151729.n: The portal hums quietly and surprisingly evenly.

t: The portal systems are in motion...
The portal hums quietly and surprisingly evenly.
r151779.n: The portal hums quietly and surprisingly evenly.

t: Systems operate at their full capacity!
r151806.n: Initiate the final stage of the unlocking process

t: The terminal seems to be waiting for your actions...
r151808.n: The terminal seems to be waiting for your actions...

t: But we hardly have the strength to fight those behind it. These demons look larger and more formidable than those we have met before. My strength is already running out, and so is yours...
r151813.n: The sacrifices are necessary - what we need lies behind this barrier. It looks like even…

t: Yes, it took us all a lot of effort... I feel sorry for those who were left behind.
r151814.n: We are finally in the right place. These endless teleportations, break-ins, demons...

r151815.n: Reniesta, start removing the barrier, and we'll get ready for the fight.

t:
We've been wandering through endless identical levels and corridors for months...

If I understand correctly, this Citadel is manipulating space... It folds it like a sheet of paper... Nihaz's Box that has one double bottom after another.

What are we looking for? Only you know that, Klavdia. It looks like the center of... this web.
r151816.n: What do you think about our journey?

t: Then let's get started... I feel uneasy in this place.
r151817.n: That's right. We don't need unnecessary complications.

t: Of course. I'll be protecting the terminal while you and this... Gort deal with the Citadel defenders. Everything is simple.
r151818.n: That's correct. Do you remember your role, too?

t:
Yes, I remembered everything. Three levels of protection. Removing each level will draw attention to us.

At each stage, you must enter the correct characters from left to right, and the remaining characters change every few seconds... Clever, but not enough to stop us.
r151819.n: We are close to our goal. Remember what I told you about the security systems?

t: This Citadel is bigger than I could have ever imagined...
r151820.n: This Citadel is bigger than I could have ever imagined...

t: Ugh... It's all very simple: our memories are weak reflections of the reality we know, but it's different with gods. Without going into detail: my memories will be like an incredibly realistic dream to you. The difference is that this dream is controlled by me, so I can easily and quickly convey to you all the important thoughts and emotions. Let's start already...

Listening?

There's a better way. After all, I'm not a bard to tell you long stories... And I can't rhyme at all.

Let's do it this way - I'll show you my memories. It will look no different to reality to your weak mind, no offense, which should save us both time and energy.

Let's start now. Shall we begin?

Not to send you to another Ball, don't even think about it.

We have a difficult task ahead... Perhaps the most difficult thing you've ever had to do.

End Nihaz once and for all. How? Well, let's just say there are ways.

...But first you need to know what I found in the Citadel.

r151827.n: I want to see your memoires.

r151829.n: Hmm... I'll and try and ask them.

t:
I have an idea. The thing is, your ordinary portals were created by modern spells designed for a world divided into allods. That's why astral storms can disrupt their functionality.

But June portals are different. They have a different principle of operation, and they can function even during a storm. There was a portal like that between Gipat and Suslanger... We need to find it, it's somewhere in these mountains.
Perhaps the locals might know something?
r151830.n: How do we get to Suslanger this time?

t:
Of course. We were naive to believe Nihaz wouldn't try to stop us.

Suslanger was chosen as the site for the construction of the new Gates.  Why? On the one hand, it's a rather deserted place, and on the other, it's under the protection of the Empire and its fleet.

Construction proceeded in record time. However, one day an incident occurred at the site. Most likely sabotage.

After that mysterious event, an anomaly appeared around Suslanger. Remember when Ammer appeared? The first few months, an astral storm was raging around it. It was the same there. The allod itself is intact, but the portals don't work, and ships can't reach it.

That's why we need your help. You are strong enough to return if anything goes wrong. After all, you managed to escape Tep's illusion.

The things I showed you happened a long time ago. We haven't been sitting idly in the meantime. We all have reasons to travel to another world.

Catherina dreams about progress. This project is just another accomplishment for her.

The elves are looking for the Beauty. They have seen everything in this world, so why not look somewhere else?

Aidenus and Yasker are looking for means to defeat Cosmos. The willful Aoidos and his ability to interfere in the course of history make them tremble with fear. But the Gates can pierce not just space, but also time. And even protect time from the Observatory's meddling.

We already had the Gates project. On Ferris. The loophole that led to Fractal is closed now, just like the rift on Dane. The Gates-2 project also failed. The island is under quarantine after the failed attempt to change the past by preventing Tep's Plague.

It's time to put together everything we know and can. And make a successful attempt this time, since we know the coordinates of the time and place where we need to be. To create Gates-3.
r151832.n: What are we going to do with them?

t:
It's unsurprising. I'll explain: we were looking for the coordinates of... my mother's world. And we found them.

No, it's not about my feelings. Nihaz can't get his hands on another god's powers! Right now he's trying to invade her world. But now we have the coordinates, too...
r151833.n: I can't say everything was clear in that vision.

t: We just teleported from there. Nihaz didn't even try to stop us. Perhaps he was too busy.
Here is our hero, a participant of the Great Balls and the most carefree creature in all of Sarnaut. Aren't you tired of chasing lovers and riding hares?
r151835.n: Here is our hero, a participant of the Great Balls and the most…

t:
The truth is, Suslanger is my homeland. I just needed to find something here on Gipat.

Like many of my brethren, I went through the portal on Suslanger and ended up here.

So I know exactly where this portal is. One of the bridges in the mountains leads to it - you've probably seen them, right? But you can't reach it on your own. There's a special place nearby that can help you get there.

Let's meet there, I'll show you how to reach the portal.

I'm going to smack you...!

...Yes, it's done! Go to the stele in the center, place your hand on it, and focus. I'll do the rest.
Oh, you...! Let me calibrate it properly, or I'll throw you into a volcano!
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?

The Legendary Orc is testing us!

We started the rebellion just as the prophecy foretold! We overthrew the Xadaganian dogs, gathered everyone, and went to the desert, to the old ship landfill. This is where the new dawn of the Orcs' freedom will come! And we have a proper seer now, the old Shaman Kurgan! He foretold that the Legendary Orc with magical powers will come from this portal... Well, that's you!

What are your orders...?
r151872.n: Where am I...? The Orcs are everywhere...Why?

t: Wait... You're not the Legendary Orc. You are not even an Orc! And you look pathetic!
r151874.n: Where am I...? The Orcs are everywhere...Why?

t: Legendary Orc, you're with us...! Though you look... Strange. What can you tell us?
r151875.n: Legendary Orc, you're with us...! Though you look... Strange. What can…

t: If I knew, I'd be hopping across the desert right now... Think of something!
r151882.n: How do I distract him and still get out of the cage afterwards?

t:
Wait until nightfall, of course!

...But there's another problem. Our cage is guarded by a really diligent Orc - you won't believe it, but he's actually vigilant day and night! He's standing aboard the ship right above me, see?

That's where I'll need your help. You'll distract him while I'll break the lock, and we'll get out... Then we'll improvise!
r151883.n: Hm... Fine, so what do we do?

t:
Right... I'm sure.

No, we can't do that. These Orcs are not villains, and they do more good than harm... They just lack self-awareness. What kind of hero kills everyone who gets in their way?

...No, I think we can get out of here without any casualties. We must do it this way.
r151884.n: I'm the Hero of Sarnaut! I can handle a few Orcs!

t:
Your ears work fine, it seems! Let's see if the rest of you is up to snuff...

Yes, this morning I realized I've been stuck here for too long. I need to leave, and I suspect you're not planning to stick around either.

Now here's the thing. I can break the lock on the cage, it's just a few screws and wires. But the local Orcs are a different matter. They might be poorly organized, but they're strong. In daylight, they'll grab us easily...
r151885.n: You said something about being in the same boat...?

t:
Your ghost partner? Yeah, I noticed... You have interesting friends!

I think it might work. But even that trick won't help you during the day... Let's wait for the right time and begin.
r151889.n: I think I have an idea...

t: It was easy! Of course, we're young Imperial enthusiasts, we never sit idly! A strange substance has recently appeared in the desert. It's called the Ambrosia. I went to study it... but then I was captured by these... oddly dressed fellows.

I'm Alice. A young exobiologist from a biology club. I came to Suslanger like everyone else - to spend a vacation in the famous pioneer camp "Dune", so when the portals went down, I got stuck here like all the others.
How did you end up here...?
r151892.n: How did you end up here...?

t:
I'm a ghost! People will pay attention to me if I want them to. Why do you ask... Ooh!

I get it, you need me to help you escape!

Of course I'll help. We're pals after all. Just point me to where you need me, and I'll pop right up... for seven seconds! In that time, everyone nearby will forget about you... Let's test it on the guard near the cage?
r151897.n: Erfar, do you know how to... distract people?

t:
Ah, this? That's just common jinn magic, you'll get properly acquainted with it later.

It's Jinn's Shadow, hides you from anything in the world... Especially from danger.

I borrowed it from a friend in the desert. There are more impressive things out there, trust me!
They definitely won't spot us here...
r151909.n: They definitely won't spot us here...

t:
It's the Ambrosia...

Ambrosia... someone named it that. Well, it's a name like any other.

It may seem like another kind of evil, like the Blight or the Architects. But it's not the same thing. Ambrosia is like an organism's reaction to a virus. Everything that corrupts the reality around us is a virus, and the Ambrosia kills it.

You've dealt with the forces of Darkness, Chaos, and Order before... but this is Life itself! A revitalizing injection of vitamins into the feeble body of Sarnaut. But an excess of vitamins can also be harmful. As an exobiologist, I know a thing or two about that.
r151916.n: Where did these strange scorpions come from...?

t: I won't forget this ride any time soon...
r151917.n: I won't forget this ride any time soon...

t: You find a scroll that has the following written on it: "Overlord Nezeb has been preparing to return to his former homeland for a long time. He subjugated all tribes of the desert and the entire south! Numerous forges were forging weapons from raw materials that came from quarries and ore mines scattered here and there in the desert."
Alas, there is nothing but dust...
An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What does it hold?
r151931.n: An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What…

t: You find a scroll that has the following written on it: "Numerous mages worked to enchant this weapon, for the Xadaganians had to battle the Kanians who had their own mages. The strongest of them formed the Conclave, and now the Great Nezeb had to use all his power to challenge the Kanian dogs and win!"
Alas, there is nothing but dust...
An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What does it hold?
r151940.n: An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What…

t: You find a scroll that has the following written on it: "The Great Nezeb had a special weapon - a secret guarded so carefully that I do not dare speak of it. Its power terrified his allies as it was not created by a human hand but through ancient mysterious sorcery alien to humans. But the Great Nezeb, the most cunning and powerful of us, was able to wield this power, and it greatly aided the preparations for the war..."
Alas, there is nothing but dust...
An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What does it hold?
r151946.n: An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What…

t: You find a scroll that has the following written on it: "So numerous were the weapons collected, so heavy the chests of gold and jewelry, that no caravan was able to carry this cargo out of the desert within a reasonable time. Fate dictated that the Great Nezeb should leave part of his treasures here, in the desert. Thankfully one of his allies was willing to guard these treasures... His name was the Gray Prince..."
Alas, there is nothing but dust...
An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What does it hold?
r151952.n: An ancient chest that has been buried in the sands for ages... What…

t:
You have made this journey and you don't even know where you are going? I should have kept you from entering the Court of Miracles, but I failed.

Eruption of the Ambrosia? You are talking about the divine power that awakened the jinns? We slept for centuries, for our strength began to wane after the world was split... Only a few continued to stay awake and serve the man the Great Nezeb, our master and enslaver, handed us over to.

But this eruption awakened us! We became guardians of the treasures again... But not Nezeb's this time. There's darkness threatening this world... I'll tell you what you want to know, even though I'm bound by a vow of servitude.

This Ambrosia is a divine power. It's more ancient than our world. It came to us with the girl that came here from another time. Her path took her through the city and to the desert... that's where she ran into the Orcs.

Now farewell. I serve the Gray Prince now, so don't stand in his way.
r151960.n: Why did you fight us and what are you guarding? Do you know anything about the eruption…

t: I didn't think you could defeat me...
r151961.n: I didn't think you could defeat me...

t:
How could I be there? And what makes you think so? Look how many pioneers are in the city! And you think it was me of all people?

You say a Chronophone went missing? But the Gates can still be repaired? Phew, I was afraid they were completely broken... I wonder what could cause irreparable damage?

Don't look at me like that. Theoretically speaking, I mean. You know, I want to help you. I think... the pirates did it. Yes, astral pirates got here. They needed the Chronophone, and they can disguise themselves as any pioneer. And I'm just an exobiologist. Let's try and figure out who it could be.

I doubt it. You're not even a pioneer! Who would let you stick your nose into other people's business? The pioneers have different heroes anyway...

Better deal with other problems for now, and leave that to me. And tell that to Eladia, too.
r151969.n: Can I do anything to help?

t: You're asking me... No one knows! Well, they are the pioneers - they are quite inventive. We need to find out who stole the part, and it won't be easy to wriggle into everyone's favor. But I'm working on it!
r151970.n: How long is this investigation going to take?

t: Hello! How can I help you?
r151971.n: Hello! How can I help you?

t: Hello, hello. Are you here to try your luck at treasure-hunting during the storm?
r152011.n: Hello, hello. Are you here to try your luck at treasure-hunting during…

t:
What can I tell an outsider? Spend some time here, then we'll talk.

I know every local here, and they know me. I'm always happy to help them if there's trouble, and it's the same for them.

I don't care what's happening outside the city - we're too busy maintaining order within our walls... We don't have many guards, and now there's some kind of eruption, then it's the crystals, then thieves... Anyway, less talking, more doing!
The Hero of Sarnaut, you say? We'll see...
r152033.n: The Hero of Sarnaut, you say? We'll see...

t:
I don't even know what to tell you... I'm doing my best trying to stay on top of things! First some merchants arrived, then the incident happened, then a wounded traveler was brought in...

The city is part of the desert, you understand? We have to pay attention to everything around us. We barely have time for ourselves...
Hello! I'm glad to see you!
r152063.n: Hello! I'm glad to see you!

t:
It was a pure accident!

I thought Ambrosia explosives were like the Ambrosia, that they would make everything better with their energy! I should have studied the incident carefully...

It turned out an explosion of Ambrosia doesn't affect the living, but everything inorganic gets blown to bits. At least no one got injured, or else they would have kicked me out of the city...

Well, I... Study. Everything unusual. I used to study jinns before, and now, after the Incident, it's the Ambrosia... There is so much we haven't discovered yet, even among the things we're used to, you know?

I can't say I'm doing really well, but it's a long process - changing the world with your discoveries. Perhaps I'll succeed when I'm old...

But it's particularly hard right now - after I blew up a city district, everyone turned away from me...
Hmm.. Why didn't I think of this before?
r152091.n: Hmm.. Why didn't I think of this before?

t:
She and Fomkin just can't stop getting in and out!

To the town, to the mountains, to the lake! All I do is register their leaves and returns!

Please, talk to her.
r152098.n: I hear you have the camp logs. Does Alice go out often?

t:
Alice?

Hmmm... you know, you're right. She's a pretender!

Before she came along, I had been the best student! Now she's the straight A-student. She knows history better than me, she knows astral geography, and even PE is her forte! No normal human is capable of it!
Alice? What would you like to know?
r152100.n: Hey! Can you tell me something about Alice?

r152103.n: Alright, you obviously don't understand. Let me put it another way.

t: Hah! It's you who arrived with that fat orc, right? The pioneer leader Nina accepted you in the ranks! I don't think that a militia officer needs to be accepted. You're probably doing your own dark stuff here.
r152104.n: I'm a militia officer. Looking for a young criminal named Alice.

t:
She told me about it. She told me about that one time when you saved her from the lizards. However, when you were running away from orcs, it was her who saved you, not the other way round. But oh well.

I've known Alice for a while. If you need to talk, you should talk to her directly.
r152105.n: I saved Alice's life in the desert. Twice.

t: A friend, you say? Can you prove it? Literally anyone can come here and claim to be Alice's friend.
r152106.n: I'm Alice's friend, I need to warn her.

t: Oh really? Then our talk doesn't matter either. Quit sniffing around, you! Do something useful. Weed the flower beds or sweep the pavement. It's better than hanging around, harassing people with meaningless stuff.
r152107.n: It doesn't matter who I am.

t: Kolya and I are trying to solve Alice's problem. It's a difficult matter. There are suspicious persons sniffing around. They might be the pirates she mentioned.

I'm Phima. I mean, Yephim. Why?

Ah, it's you. How is Alice? Did she have anything for me?

Main course:

 • Goat barbecue, Suslanger style.

 • Bacon crisps with sour cream.

 • Hashbrowns with green peas.
r152159.n: Main course: • Goat barbecue, Suslanger style. • Bacon crisps with…

t:
Beverages:

 • Xadaganian kefir. 1% fat.

 • Cappuccino.

 • Sweet cranberry compote.
r152165.n: Beverages: • Xadaganian kefir. 1% fat. • Cappuccino. • Sweet cranberry…

t:
Soups:

 • Red borscht, meat broth.

 • Cheese soup.

 • Sorrel soup, vegetable broth.
r152191.n: Soups: • Red borscht, meat broth. • Cheese soup. • Sorrel soup,…

t:
Hasn't Nina told you? Or did you simply forget? Alright, listen.

First of all, we do a roll call and a headcount during lineups. Say "ME!" every time you hear your name.

Second, we have a problem with the pioneer troop number two. They're always telling each other stupid jokes, making a lot of noise. Stand next to them and block their attempts.

Third, if you let the lineup be disrupted, I'll have to kick you out.

Got it?
r152198.n: What happens during lineups? What's my duty?

t: Another day, another lineup. Oh, what an endless pioneer cycle...
r152199.n: Another day, another lineup. Oh, what an endless pioneer cycle...

t: I want to give a speech before the start. You know our pioneers. They love making noise, disturb the peace, and break the order. I get very nervous when I'm interrupted. If I stutter three times, I'll have to start over again. Can you please watch them? Hush them if they make noise. Okay? And then we get to watch the motion history together.
r152259.n: What do I need to do?

t: Great! You're here! I'm beside myself! So nervous! So?
r152260.n: Great! You're here! I'm beside myself! So nervous! So?

t:
Oh, you've found it! Let me have it, quick! Oooh, it's intact! Wait. An actress, you say? Now that's not good at all. We don't show our work to the cast before the premier night. Otherwise they'll be unhappy with what we shot. And I don't want to deal with "ooooh, my legs don't look good in this scene, let's get another take on that." I hate it. I hope, she gave you nothing of the sort. Good, good.

Ugh. Alright, at least, now we have the SACK. Now we need to assemble the device. Will you help me?
r152314.n: Here you go. One of your actresses had it.

t:
I'm a cameraman, I deal with the camera, testing how my actors and I can tolerate stress. And when I'm done, I grab my big scissors and begin to cut. And glue. The footage requires a steady hand, the ability to choose, and a creative approach. When I said "cut," I meant I could cut any slacker there is, hehe.

Did I mention stress tolerance? It's really getting on my nerves.

I once saw a news host on manavision show showing life in Sarnaut. Battles, journeys, fates... you might know the announcer. Later on, he worked with the Goblin Banker, announcing new collectible bundles.

He impressed me very much. He was so eager to tell everything that I fell like show everything that was going on in Sarnaut. At that time, the Dream Factory was hiring a cameraman, so I thought, why not?
r152316.n: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

t: I'm Konstantin Ulitin. Working for the greater good of the Motion Stories. Sometimes I have to go on sedatives, but only a little.

I came back from a spa treatment... And discovered that almost every crew member uses a nickname. Not their real names. You've been shaking hands, not knowing who they actually are...

Now I know why this job is so hard - I have to work with creative people! That's the effect of the treatment! Life can throw funnier insights at you.
r152318.n: I came back from a spa treatment... And discovered that almost every…

t: Why wouldn't I? We allow everyone, who can keep discipline and wishes to become a pioneer. Besides, as far as I was informed, she was left behind in the Old City after the portals were closed. You know, there aren't a lot of places to stay, except the pioneer camp. The city is full of tourists. And the Sanatorium is on another allod. Back in the day they were going to build it next to the pioneer camp but changed their mind. Didn't want to spoil the view. There are no more ships.
r152347.n: Why did you let Alice join?

t: She's a member of the pioneer troop three if I remember correctly. Not the best troop in terms of discipline, but we have what we have. They had an opening, so they took her. You want to look for her next to their lodgings. Even if they're out, you will surely see them at the pioneer lineup.
Hm... let me see. She joined shortly after the Incident. Other pioneers stumbled upon her in the city. She told them that she was all alone, no papers, no family. So they invited her to join.
As a superintendent, I know everything about everyone. What exactly do you want to know?
...the SACK object? That's right! It was taken to the first cabin to the left of the camp entrance, where the Dream Factory is.
No! Absolutely not! Buoys mark the perimeter of swimming areas! You are not allowed to swim beyond them!
r152353.n: Can I swim beyond the buoys?

t: We are getting ready! Sewing costumes, singing songs, memorizing poems!
r152354.n: How are the preparations for the holiday going?

t: Everything is great, friend. All pioneers are keeping busy - participating in activity clubs or doing sports. Discipline is maintained at all times.
r152355.n: How are things in the pioneer camp?

t: I'm Camp Superintendent Dynin! I maintain discipline in the camp and ensure that everything is operational. What's important to us? That all pioneers are healthy, discipline is maintained, and everyone is kept busy I'm also assisting with preparations for the upcoming festivities.
Look at the structures we have built! The lawns we have laid. The water supply and heating!
r152357.n: Look at the structures we have built! The lawns we have laid. The…

t: No! I told you already, you can't! Those caught doing so will be sent home. In shame. Of course, when the port is opened.
r152358.n: Can I swim beyond the buoys?

t: Fine. Are you learning... what I told you to learn? Like I said, "vigorous" should be said more vigorously. And "joyful" - more joyfully. Got it?
r152359.n: How are the preparations for the holiday going?

t: Why do you ask? Everything is in order. Where is your leader? Why are you loitering?
r152360.n: How are things in the pioneer camp?

t: Is that how you're addressing your superior? I'm Eugene Dynin, the superintendent of this pioneer camp. I maintain discipline, supervise group leaders, and make arrangements for the upcoming festivities.
Remember, pioneers: you are the masters of the camp. You! What is required of you, my friends? Discipline!
r152362.n: Remember, pioneers: you are the masters of the camp. You! What is…

t: I don't know yet... I think you need Hassan ibn Khottab. It's always safe there, and it's easy to get anywhere from that place...
r152397.n: Great news! Well, where should I take you?

t:
That's nice to hear... Thank you for your honesty. Hopefully I will live up to that.

By the way, my investigation is going well! The pioneers turned out to be even more cunning than I thought, but I have a couple of leads... I'm not sure when I'll figure it out, but I will.
r152398.n: Yes, I care about you. [Alice will remember that]

t:
Well… This is probably how you became the Hero of Sarnaut. Thank you for your honesty.

Regarding our business... My investigation is going well! The pioneers turned out to be even more cunning than I thought, but I have a couple of leads... I'm not sure when I'll figure it out, but I will.
r152399.n: It's nothing like that. I'm doing all this to save the world. [Alice will remember that]

t:
Huh? Phew... It's strong. But acts quickly. I will be able to walk in 10 seconds... But fighting and running around dungeons will only be possible in two weeks.

Do you have time? Will you accompany me to this jinn, Hassan ibn Khottab? I'll be fine on my own after that.

Oh! Give it here.

So, let's dilute it with this... We'll pour it here... Shake it properly... And swallow quickly!
How did I end up here...
r152420.n: How did I end up here...

t:
Oh, great! Anyway, this journey won't make us any poorer, that's for sure. Alright, my legs are falling asleep already.

We going? I need to get to Hassan ibn Khottab, then I'll figure out the rest...

...Just give me the chests first, you don't need to carry all this heavy stuff yourself.

Well, when the storm begins, summoning this Uro-Boros will be easy... You will run around and shout a bit - here in this suspicious hole filled with bones... And then...

My intuition tells me that it will be easier for us to... Break the worm mentally, not physically! I'm not a Psionicist for nothing. I'll have to concentrate properly for this, so... Well... You'll distract it. Any way you can. I'll try to be quick.
r152458.n: Well? What are we gonna do now?

t: Excellent. According to my information, no one should attack you. It should be a surprisingly peaceful task for this prophecy... Now take a good long look at Skulnar, then turn to me and nod in a pointed manner. It would look cool, if anyone is watching...
r152568.n: Skulnar and I are ready to go to the Landfill.

t: We need to deal with this quickly...
r152569.n: We need to deal with this quickly...

t:
Right, help. Since they sent you, find it for me. I said right away that I would work on cars, not sort through garbage.

In short, somewhere in this heap there is an engineer's chest with nuts and bolts. He left it here. It's small but it's filled with various pieces. So you need to look for it in the nearest pile of garbage.
r152636.n: Hello. Need help looking for a piece?

t:
Me? You're the one suggesting.

You will help us solve our problems with the Unyielding. Then the balance of power will be disrupted, and they won't be able to storm the cities when we attack.

It's a pleasant pastime for you, and it makes the area safe for our weaker residents.

Well?
Well, you sure don't lack for courage. The only reason we left you alone was because we already had our hands full. Tell me why you're here, or get out while you can.

Your broad is organizing everything. As far as I understand, she's... Pretty cool, what else can you say.

All we need to do is create the right atmosphere while the others are getting ready. Let's sit down?
r152686.n: How is the recruitment process set up?

t: Well, look... You are here, Skulnar is here, the guys are here... Everyone is here, and even the Unyielding have gone quiet. Which means we start now! And if someone's late - that's their problem...

The old goat is still alive? Can he even raise the belt?

It's the same thing every time. He should retire already. It's rightly said that if an orc lived to twenty five, he's not an orc but a piece of shit! And he's almost forty. Senility is around the corner!

Guess I'm going to punch him in the face the next time I see him. I owe him a few grudges.

The old man? Oh, I'll do it myself. I've been thinking of visiting my ancestral home, so to speak. It's the same thing every time. He should retire already. It's rightly said that if an orc lived to twenty five, he's not an orc but a piece of shit! And he's almost forty. Senility is around the corner!

Tell him I haven’t punched him in a while, and I'm itching to kick his ass. Gotta be a sign that I'll see him soon.
r152693.n: Do you want to me to tell Crazystorm anything?
